fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the first game image on Z-Man Games' product page https://www.zmangames.com/game/pandemic-legacy-season-1/. The publisher product title corresponds to this rule edition; reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: Take all the pawns and blindly draw one. That pawn’s player goes first.
clarifications: This is the last setup step (“Begin play”), done at the start of each game in the campaign.
Play proceeds clockwise: after a player finishes infecting cities, the player on their left goes next.
